description: WBMOD estimates ionospheric irregularities and radio scintillation for a specified propagation geometry. The empirical formulation supports radio-link assessment under selected environmental conditions. The resource is documented by NorthWest Research Associates, Inc. The documented physical domain is High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region, Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The provider says source-code release is controlled by US import/export regulations; access permission must be checked separately. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.

discovery_routes.query: Complete model catalogue; select one version per model with stated space-weather infrastructure impacts

inputs: There are three categories of inputs to WBMOD: (1) environment state variables, (2) system definition variables, and (3) model control variables. (1) Environment State Variable Inputs: Sunspot number, Kp, location
